proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : Finset.Ico 1 1 = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₂ : properUnitaryDivisors 1 = ∅ := by
    rw [show properUnitaryDivisors 1 = {d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 1 | d ∣ 1 ∧ d.Coprime (1 / d)} by rfl]
    rw [h₁]
    <;> simp [Finset.filter_empty]
    <;> aesop
  
  apply h₂
